newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR GREECE V CROATIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR GREECE V CROATIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
